t: This is the Genesis Cinema in Tower Hamlets, a cinema that began life as a theatre. The theatre was designed by Frank Matcham, an architect who specialised in theatres and music halls. He worked all over the country, with more than ninety theatres designed from scratch and about eighty more redesigned or refurbished. In London he is behind the Coliseum, the Palladium, Hackney Empire and Shepherd's Bush Empire. So this building is one of a large family of Matcham auditoriums, now showing films instead of variety acts.
